mapper.select: SELECT cr.id, cr.order_id, cr.checkitem_id, cr.result_status, cr.report_time, c.name AS checkitem_name, c.type AS checkitem_type, c.sort_no FROM cireport cr LEFT JOIN checkitem c ON c.id = cr.checkitem_id WHERE cr.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY c.sort_no ASC

SELECT cr.id, cr.order_id, cr.checkitem_id, cr.result_status, cr.report_time, c.name AS checkitem_name, c.type AS checkitem_type, c.sort_no FROM cireport cr LEFT JOIN checkitem c ON c.id = cr.checkitem_id WHERE cr.order_id = #{orderId} AND cr.checkitem_id = #{checkitemId}
